title: How I'd build a one-person business (if I started over in 2026)

sentences.en: I think it's obvious that everything is changing right now.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很明显，现在一切都在变。

sentences.en: Business. The internet.
sentences.zh: 商业在变，互联网在变。

sentences.en: Social media. Coding. Art.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体、编程、艺术，全都在变。

sentences.en: It feels like what worked just last year doesn't work anymore.
sentences.zh: 感觉去年还管用的东西，今年已经不管用了。

sentences.en: And since we're here to talk about the one person business or just online business as a whole because it applies to everything.
sentences.zh: 既然我们是来聊一人企业、或者说整个线上生意的——因为这适用于所有领域——

sentences.en: I'm not here to give you just some recycled advice, right?
sentences.zh: 我不是来给你讲那些老掉牙的建议的，对吧？
现在是2026年。

sentences.en: We're going into 2026.
sentences.zh: 我们正进入2026年。

sentences.en: Everyone's creating the the best business model to start in 2026.
sentences.zh: 所有人都在做"2026年最值得启动的商业模式"这类视频。

sentences.en: Videos I am to for the views, but with most of those videos they're just saying the same thing they did in 2025.
sentences.zh: 我也做这种视频，为了流量。但这类视频里，大多数人只是在重复他们2025年说过的话。

sentences.en: And that was okay when they were saying it last year and the year before because not much changed.
sentences.zh: 去年、前年说那些话还行，因为变化不大。

sentences.en: So I'm not going to tell you to start an agency.
sentences.zh: 所以我不会告诉你去开一家代理公司。

sentences.en: I'm not going to tell you to start freelancing.
sentences.zh: 我不会告诉你去接自由职业。

sentences.en: I'm not going to tell you to even build an info product.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不会告诉你去做什么信息产品。

sentences.en: I'm not even going to tell you to start coaching or consulting or whatever the popular business model was like starting a community or anything.
sentences.zh: 我更不会告诉你去搞教练、咨询，或者任何之前流行的商业模式，比如建社群之类的。

sentences.en: And I've already talked about those plenty of times in the past.
sentences.zh: 这些我过去已经讲过无数次了。

sentences.en: Just go look at the one person business playlist on my channel, but instead I want to show you the business model that I think makes sense right now for the next 2 to 3 years, maybe.
sentences.zh: 你直接去看我频道里的一人企业播放列表就行。但今天，我想给你看一个我认为现在、以及未来两三年可能都行得通的商业模式。

sentences.en: And the reason I'm making this video is because I keep seeing online because they're trying to get views to that value based content is dead, or info products are dead or coaching is dead.
sentences.zh: 我做这期视频的原因是，我老在网上看到——他们为了流量——说价值型内容死了，信息产品死了，教练也死了。

sentences.en: And what that's doing is it's making people feel like they just shouldn't start as a creator.
sentences.zh: 这带来的后果是，让人觉得干脆别当创作者了。

sentences.en: They should just give up and not even try because they don't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得自己应该放弃，连试都别试，因为他们不知道该做什么。

sentences.en: But that's just kind of how things go when a new paradigm starts to emerge, because it's not like that paradigm is figured out yet.
sentences.zh: 但这其实就是新范式开始出现时的常态，因为这个范式还没被摸透。

sentences.en: It's it's not clear that nobody can just tell you what to do.
sentences.zh: 它还不清晰，没人能直接告诉你该怎么做。

sentences.en: You kind of have to try new things and experiment until you create the new thing.
sentences.zh: 你只能去尝试新东西、不断实验，直到你创造出那个新的东西。

sentences.en: So let's talk about how the one person business is changing, and then let's talk about the future of education and specifically education products, and then how you can actually take advantage of this.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们先聊聊一人企业正在怎么变，然后聊聊教育的未来，特别是教育类产品，最后聊聊你怎么真正抓住这个机会。

sentences.en: Like what you can literally start doing and learning today.
sentences.zh: 也就是你今天就可以开始做什么、学什么。

sentences.en: So part one, the one person business model is evolving because for the past few decades, info products and coaching just reigned supreme. That's what you did.
sentences.zh: 第一部分：一人企业模式正在进化。因为过去几十年，信息产品和教练就是王道，你就只能做这个。

sentences.en: If you wanted to be a creator and you didn't want to rely on sponsorships and ad revenue, you would build an info product or you would do coaching.
sentences.zh: 如果你想当创作者，又不想依赖赞助和广告收入，你就得做信息产品，或者做教练。

sentences.en: And I think those were great things because with the internet as one person, those were kind of your only options.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那些东西很棒，因为作为一个人，在互联网上，那几乎是你仅有的选择。

sentences.en: That's how as one singular person, that is the caveat here.
sentences.zh: 这就是一个人——注意，这里有个前提——

sentences.en: One singular person, not a team.
sentences.zh: 一个单打独斗的人，不是一个团队。

sentences.en: You could start an entire business online.
sentences.zh: 你可以在线上启动一整个生意。

sentences.en: That's crazy. That's insane.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了，太不可思议了。

sentences.en: One single person could be their own marketing, content, sales, product, and even, I guess, HR department.
sentences.zh: 一个人可以同时是自己的营销、内容、销售、产品，甚至，算是人事部门。

sentences.en: You write content to get traffic without needing a physical business in the right location.
sentences.zh: 你写内容获取流量，不需要实体店铺，不需要在正确的地段。

sentences.en: You do something interesting with your life or learn one of your passions enough until you become somewhat of an expert, and then you share that thing with others in an educational or entertaining way.
sentences.zh: 你用自己的生活去做一些有意思的事，或者把你热爱的东西学到足够深，直到你差不多成了半个专家，然后你用一种教育或娱乐的方式，把那些东西分享给别人。

sentences.en: Your brand is you.
sentences.zh: 你的品牌就是你自己。

sentences.en: Your content or little pieces of your mind and your products are processes that solve the problem in your life and led to something better.
sentences.zh: 你的内容，也就是你头脑中的碎片，以及你的产品，是解决你生活中某个问题、并带来了更好结果的流程。

sentences.en: Many people overcomplicate that.
sentences.zh: 很多人把这事搞得太复杂了。

sentences.en: One example that I would always give is if you love productivity, that was one of your passions.
sentences.zh: 我经常举的一个例子是，如果你热爱生产力，那是你的热情所在。

sentences.en: You study productivity.
sentences.zh: 你去研究生产力。

sentences.en: Then you start talking about productivity online.
sentences.zh: 然后你开始在线上聊生产力。

sentences.en: You iterate because your content isn't going to be good at first, so you improve it until it gets good and you start growing.
sentences.zh: 你不断迭代，因为你的内容一开始不会好，所以你持续改进，直到它变好，你开始增长。

sentences.en: And then you use that traffic to feed into a product.
sentences.zh: 然后你用那些流量去喂养一个产品。

sentences.en: What do you build for a product?
sentences.zh: 你要做什么产品？

sentences.en: I don't know, what do you buy?
sentences.zh: 我不知道，你买过什么？

sentences.en: What did you buy that helped you with productivity?
sentences.zh: 你买过什么东西帮你提升了生产力？

sentences.en: Was it a planner? In that case, you go to Amazon.
sentences.zh: 是一个计划本吗？如果是的话，你去 Amazon。

sentences.en: You order the top five planners, you break them down, you use them, you deconstruct them.
sentences.zh: 你下单排名前五的计划本，你拆解它们，使用它们，解构它们。

sentences.en: You understand what you do and don't like about the planners, and then you create your own.
sentences.zh: 你搞清楚你喜欢和不喜欢这些计划本的什么地方，然后你创造你自己的。

sentences.en: It doesn't even have to be a physical product.
sentences.zh: 它甚至不需要是一个实体产品。

sentences.en: You can create a notion template or even a printable planner or a course, plus those things that it's really up to you.
sentences.zh: 你可以做一个 Notion 模板，或者一个可打印的计划本，或者一门课程，外加那些东西，完全由你决定。

sentences.en: And in order to make 50,000, 100, thousand, $500,000 a year, it's really just those two levers, right?
sentences.zh: 而为了每年赚 5 万、10 万、50 万美元，真的就靠那两个杠杆，对吧？

sentences.en: You write content, you get traffic, and depending on the amount of traffic you get and how good your product actually is, that results in the amount of money that you make.
sentences.zh: 你写内容，你获得流量，然后根据你获得的流量多少以及你的产品实际有多好，就决定了你赚多少钱。

sentences.en: And the beautiful thing there is that your value isn't determined by an employer.
sentences.zh: 这件事美妙的地方在于，你的价值不由雇主决定。

sentences.en: Your value is practically uncapped.
sentences.zh: 你的价值几乎没有上限。

sentences.en: Depending on how many people you reach.
sentences.zh: 取决于你触达了多少人。

sentences.en: So this quickly forces you to kind of remove the employment mindset from your mind, because you can make so much more just as one person.
sentences.zh: 所以这会很快迫使你把那种打工思维从脑子里清除出去，因为仅仅作为一个人，你就能多赚这么多。

sentences.en: The thing here is that this is never going to go away, but the vessel by which you do it will continue to change.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，这件事本身永远不会消失，但你做这件事的载体在持续变化。

sentences.en: So it may not be a planner that you print out anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以它可能不再是你打印出来的一个计划本了。

sentences.en: Now, my entire goal with my brand in these videos is to help you become futureproof. That's one of my passions.
sentences.zh: 现在，我做这个品牌、做这些视频的全部目标，就是帮你变得面向未来。那是我的热情之一。

sentences.en: That's what I like educating and entertaining around and becoming future proof to me is built around two pillars.
sentences.zh: 那是我喜欢围绕它做教育和娱乐的东西，而对我来说，变得面向未来是建立在两个支柱之上的。

sentences.en: The first is how do you figure out what you want in life, which incorporates psychology, philosophy, and personal development.
sentences.zh: 第一是，你怎么搞清楚你在人生中想要什么，这融合了心理学、哲学和个人发展。

sentences.en: And then number two is how do you succeed with that?
sentences.zh: 然后第二是，你怎么用它获得成功？

sentences.en: In today's world, to reach that to what you want in life.
sentences.zh: 在当今世界，去够到你人生中想要的东西。

sentences.en: And that involves skill acquisition, business, technology and now I so previously on the internet, the second part of that, how do you succeed in today's world, especially as one person that was largely handled by having a personal brand and creating an information product or coaching information and product and coaching, they're kind of the same thing.
sentences.zh: 这涉及技能获取、商业、技术，以及现在的 AI。所以之前在网上，第二部分，也就是你怎么在当今世界获得成功，尤其是作为一个人，很大程度上是靠拥有一个个人品牌，然后创造一个信息产品或教练服务。信息和产品、教练，它们差不多是一回事。

sentences.en: Just one is one on one, the other is mass scale.
sentences.zh: 只是一个是一对一，另一个是规模化。

sentences.en: And that info product could evolve from a simple e-book.
sentences.zh: 那个信息产品可以从一本简单的电子书开始演变。

sentences.en: Level one, a course, level two, a cohort, level three, and a community level four.
sentences.zh: 第一级，一门课程；第二级，一个同期训练营；第三级，一个社群；第四级。

sentences.en: But now since Value-based content and info products are dead, I think there's something a bit deeper at play here.
sentences.zh: 但现在，基于价值的内容和信息产品已经死了，我觉得背后有更深层的东西在起作用。

sentences.en: You still pursue your curiosities and interests and share it with other people, but the vessel for doing that is no longer a static PDF, a course or community.
sentences.zh: 你仍然追求你的好奇心和兴趣，并与他人分享，但承载这件事的载体不再是静态的PDF、课程或社群。

sentences.en: Now, before we continue into the things you're actually here for, I want to make something very clear.
sentences.zh: 在我们继续深入你真正关心的内容之前，我想把一件事说清楚。

sentences.en: I am not on the jaded side that just thinks all info products are a scam.
sentences.zh: 我不是那种愤世嫉俗、觉得所有信息产品都是骗局的人。

sentences.en: I think they are life changing in many ways.
sentences.zh: 我认为它们在很多方面能改变人生。

sentences.en: Yes, sure, some are scams. Obviously.
sentences.zh: 没错，当然有些是骗局。这很明显。

sentences.en: I think they are the antidote to the negative aspects of traditional education, i.e. conformity and getting trained into a job that you hate and not seeing any other option.
sentences.zh: 我认为它们是传统教育负面影响的解药，也就是那种让你变得顺从、被训练去做一份你讨厌的工作、并且看不到其他选择的教育。

sentences.en: The default path I do not think that info products are going away for good.
sentences.zh: 我并不认为信息产品会永远消失。

sentences.en: I do not think that they are dead.
sentences.zh: 我不认为它们死了。

sentences.en: What I say in this video will not apply to every single industry or niche.
sentences.zh: 我在这支视频里说的，不会适用于每一个行业或细分领域。

sentences.en: But as with any career sector right now, especially thanks to AI, the baseline that gets results has been raised.
sentences.zh: 但和现在任何职业领域一样，尤其是因为AI，能拿到结果的基准线已经被抬高了。

sentences.en: An average person at a low level of development can take the quick and easy route very easily.
sentences.zh: 一个处于低发展水平的普通人，可以非常轻松地走捷径。

sentences.en: You can tell AI to generate an e-book on this topic to write viral content on this topic, to generate some images and assets and call it art.
sentences.zh: 你可以让AI就某个话题生成一本电子书，生成病毒式内容，生成一些图片和素材，然后称之为艺术。

sentences.en: And those can make some form of money, but those people will never compete with those who understand what's going on.
sentences.zh: 这些东西确实能赚到某种形式的钱，但那些人永远无法与真正理解背后逻辑的人竞争。

sentences.en: In other words, it's never been easier to start a mediocre one person business.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，启动一个平庸的一人企业从未如此简单。

sentences.en: But if you don't want to be in the lower class, I hate saying that of the creator economy and the lower the lower class absolutely exists.
sentences.zh: 但如果你不想沦为底层——我很讨厌这么说——创作者经济里绝对存在底层。

sentences.en: You need to understand something very important.
sentences.zh: 你需要理解一件非常重要的事。

sentences.en: So that leads into part two, which is why info products are dying.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了第二部分：为什么信息产品正在消亡。

sentences.en: And I promise you have to understand this.
sentences.zh: 我向你保证，你必须理解这一点。

sentences.en: I know this is just theory before we actually get into it, but you have to change your mind.
sentences.zh: 我知道在我们真正深入之前，这听起来只是理论，但你必须改变你的思维。

sentences.en: You have to understand what's going on.
sentences.zh: 你必须理解正在发生什么。

sentences.en: You don't understand by me giving you practical steps.
sentences.zh: 你不可能通过我给你实操步骤来理解。

sentences.en: If you just want the practical steps and you want to fail, then go take this YouTube video, paste it into some transcription tool like Eden and go ahead, try and follow it and fail.
sentences.zh: 如果你只想要实操步骤，并且想失败，那就把这段YouTube视频拿去，粘贴到某个像Eden这样的转录工具里，然后尽管去试，然后失败。

sentences.en: Info products are dying because markets move through predictable stages of awareness and saturation.
sentences.zh: 信息产品正在消亡，是因为市场会经历可预测的认知和饱和阶段。

sentences.en: So Eugene Schwartz, legendary copywriter, categorized these into five stages.
sentences.zh: 传奇文案写手Eugene Schwartz把这分为五个阶段。

sentences.en: At level one, when nobody is in the market yet, you just state what your product does in that tends to do the job.
sentences.zh: 在第一阶段，当市场上还没有人的时候，你只需要说明你的产品是做什么的，这往往就够了。

sentences.en: Then competitors arrive and you have to make bigger claims.
sentences.zh: 然后竞争者出现，你必须做出更大的承诺。

sentences.en: Then the market gets skeptical.
sentences.zh: 接着市场开始变得怀疑。

sentences.en: So you explain your mechanism.
sentences.zh: 于是你解释你的机制。

sentences.en: So saying I will help you make money online started to sound like a scam.
sentences.zh: 所以，“我会帮你在线上赚钱”这种说法开始听起来像骗局。

sentences.en: And you had to be more specific like implement the two hour content ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 你必须更具体，比如“实施两小时内容生态系统”。

sentences.en: Shout out to you if you know what that's from.
sentences.zh: 如果你知道这是从哪里来的，向你致敬。

sentences.en: But then competitors copy that mechanism.
sentences.zh: 但接着竞争者会复制那个机制。

sentences.en: And finally everyone is exhausted by claims all together and brand starts to be the major differentiator which is happening right now. With personal branding.
sentences.zh: 最后，所有人都对承诺感到疲惫，品牌开始成为主要的差异化因素，这就是现在正在发生的事，个人品牌的时代。

sentences.en: People crave the sense of belonging they get from joining a tribe with a mission, and I've talked about that before.
sentences.zh: 人们渴望那种归属感，那种加入一个有使命的部落所带来的归属感，我之前聊过这个。

sentences.en: I'll link a newsletter that I wrote on how your mission is your knees, rather than a specific skill or topic that will help you a lot if you don't know that yet.
sentences.zh: 我会放一篇 newsletter 的链接，讲的是你的使命才是你的核心，而不是某个具体的技能或话题，如果你还没搞明白这点，那篇文章会很有帮助。

sentences.en: But community and authenticity matter more than who has the best sounding product.
sentences.zh: 但社区和真实性，比谁的产品听起来更厉害更重要。

sentences.en: The thing is, we've hit the final stage of market sophistication across the board with info products, so the really, really good ones are still going to do really, really good.
sentences.zh: 问题是，信息产品这个领域，我们已经全面进入了市场成熟度的最后阶段，所以那些真正顶尖的产品依然会卖得很好。

sentences.en: But the average ones, which is average, which is the majority, most people are going to do really bad.
sentences.zh: 但那些平庸的产品，也就是大多数，绝大多数人都会做得很差。

sentences.en: And that also means that since we're kind of like at the top of this level, that authenticity in and of itself doesn't make a difference anymore.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着，既然我们已经处在这个阶段的顶端，真实性本身已经不再构成差异化优势了。

sentences.en: People are just tired of seeing courses and coaching, and it sucks because those things are impactful if you're a clear thinker.
sentences.zh: 人们就是看腻了课程和教练服务，这很可惜，因为如果你是个清晰的思考者，这些东西其实很有影响力。

sentences.en: But there's more to this.
sentences.zh: 但事情不止于此。

sentences.en: The select few who are smart enough to transcend info products as a whole will be the ones who win.
sentences.zh: 少数足够聪明、能整体超越信息产品的人，才会是最终的赢家。

sentences.en: No transcending doesn't mean that you just leave them behind.
sentences.zh: 不，超越并不意味着你直接把它们抛在身后。

sentences.en: It means that you evolve to the next level and integrate them.
sentences.zh: 而是你进化到下一个层级，并把它们整合进来。

sentences.en: Because education and learning as a whole is just never going to go away.
sentences.zh: 因为教育和学习这件事本身，永远不会消失。

sentences.en: But since you are competing in the space as one single person, things can become saturated quite quickly.
sentences.zh: 但既然你是以一个人的身份在这个领域竞争，市场饱和的速度会非常快。

sentences.en: So what I'm going to tell you isn't going to be secure for long, because the next level is just around the corner.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在要告诉你的东西，不会安全太久，因为下一个阶段已经近在眼前了。

sentences.en: Info products didn't last that long, maybe like a decade, ten years, 15 years, and the next phase isn't going to even last that long, maybe 2 to 3 years.
sentences.zh: 信息产品没火多久，大概十年，十年到十五年，而下一个阶段甚至不会持续那么长，可能两到三年。

sentences.en: And who knows what business is going to look like after that.
sentences.zh: 谁知道那之后的商业会变成什么样。

sentences.en: We will be building for tomorrow rather than building for a year from now.
sentences.zh: 我们将为明天而构建，而不是为一年后构建。

sentences.en: Imagine that that speed of iteration is just going to continue to pick up.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，这种迭代速度只会继续加快。

sentences.en: So you have to be very speedy because that's the main advantage of being one person, right?
sentences.zh: 所以你必须非常快，因为这就是一人企业的主要优势，对吧？

sentences.en: Speed and adaptability.
sentences.zh: 速度和适应性。

sentences.en: You don't have all of this overhead.
sentences.zh: 你没有那么多包袱。

sentences.en: You don't have this team.
sentences.zh: 你没有团队。

sentences.en: You can pick up and change things tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 你明天就可以调整方向、改变一切。

sentences.en: You must constantly be moving and iterating if you want to reach the escape velocity.
sentences.zh: 你必须持续行动、持续迭代，才能达到逃逸速度。

sentences.en: That actually gives you the advantage that can't be taken away from from one person.
sentences.zh: 那才能真正给你带来别人无法从你身上夺走的优势。

sentences.en: What I mean is moving beyond the one person business.
sentences.zh: 我说的是超越一人企业。

sentences.en: After you've seen a good amount of success, because you'll just be competing with the same amount of people forever.
sentences.zh: 在你取得一定程度的成功后，因为否则你就会永远和同一批人竞争。

sentences.en: And of course, AI is just going to continue to make it easier and easier to copy the front runners so you're not going to be a front runner for long.
sentences.zh: 当然，AI 只会让复制领先者变得越来越容易，所以你领先的时间不会太长。

sentences.en: I see this with my content, so to say.
sentences.zh: 我自己的内容就是这样。

sentences.en: For the longest time, I'm not like this crazy guy who just creates all these trends.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里，我并不是那种疯狂创造各种趋势的人。

sentences.en: But once I have like an original idea, for once it gets copied very quick and then it doesn't even seem like an original idea anymore in that that time from something being original to being non original is just happening like really, really fast.
sentences.zh: 但一旦我有了一个原创想法，它很快就会被复制，然后它看起来就不再像原创了，从原创到不再原创的时间，正在变得非常非常快。

sentences.en: But there's good news here.
sentences.zh: 但这里有好消息。

sentences.en: Most people just don't do anything that sounds harsh, but you're probably in an internet echo chamber of like ambitious people.
sentences.zh: 大多数人什么都不做，这话听起来很刺耳，但你很可能处在一个充满野心家的互联网回音室里。

sentences.en: If you're watching my videos, you're probably in that echo chamber.
sentences.zh: 如果你在看我的视频，你大概率就在那个回音室里。

sentences.en: But the average person just still treats AI as like someone to ask questions or they hate AI.
sentences.zh: 但普通人仍然只把 AI 当成一个问问题的工具，或者干脆讨厌 AI。

sentences.en: And that may never change because the average person doesn't use their free time to learn and explore.
sentences.zh: 这也许永远不会改变，因为普通人不会用空闲时间去学习和探索。

sentences.en: The average person just thinks that they can do one thing, see some success, then do it for the rest of their life, and then never do anything again because they were sold.
sentences.zh: 普通人只是觉得，他们可以做一件事，看到一些成功，然后这辈子就干这个，再也不用做任何别的事了，因为他们被灌输了一个观念。

sentences.en: This illusory retirement where all of their efforts pay off and they can just chill for the rest of their life.
sentences.zh: 那个虚幻的退休——所有努力都得到了回报，余生就可以躺平了。

sentences.en: And we all know that's not meaningful at all.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道那根本毫无意义。

sentences.en: The mechanical or linear way of life is not something to bet your future on, because meaning is generated from struggle, status, and curiosity.
sentences.zh: 机械的、线性的生活方式不值得你把未来押在上面，因为意义来自于挣扎、地位和好奇心。

sentences.en: The day you stop following one of those drives is the day that your life continues to get considerably worse.
sentences.zh: 你停止追随其中任何一个驱动力的那一天，就是你的人生开始持续恶化的那一天。

sentences.en: And finally, that leads to part three, which is the future of education products.
sentences.zh: 最后，这引出了第三部分：教育产品的未来。

sentences.en: And I want to start this off with a quote from my book, Purpose and Profit, that's free to read on my Substack.
sentences.zh: 我想用我书里的一句话来开场，书名叫《Purpose and Profit》，在我的 Substack 上可以免费读。

sentences.en: It's no longer about sitting in front of a government trained expert and learning the same thing as everyone else to end up with a soon to be irrelevant skill stack.
sentences.zh: 重点不再是坐在一个政府培训出来的专家面前，和所有人学一样的东西，最后得到一个很快就会被淘汰的技能组合。

sentences.en: It's about finding someone you relate with, someone with a shared vision for the future.
sentences.zh: 重点是找到一个你能产生共鸣的人，一个对未来的愿景与你一致的人。

sentences.en: Now, if you've watched my videos, you know I've always held this firm belief, even when everyone else thinks that information products are a scam, that the creator economy is this interest based education system that is far more effective than traditional schooling at teaching people the skills that are actually relevant right now.
sentences.zh: 如果你看过我的视频，你就知道我一直坚定地持有这个信念——即使其他所有人都觉得信息产品是骗局——创作者经济是一种基于兴趣的教育体系，在教人们当下真正相关的技能方面，远比传统学校教育更有效。

sentences.en: I believe that people learn more faster when they learn it from someone that they relate with.
sentences.zh: 我相信，当人们向一个自己能产生共鸣的人学习时，他们学得更快、更多。

sentences.en: I believe that anyone can follow 4 to 5 people on a topic and become very good at that thing very fast.
sentences.zh: 我相信，任何人都可以在一个主题上关注四到五个人，然后非常快地变得非常擅长那件事。

sentences.en: I still hold the belief that there is knowledge and experience that only you can acquire, and I think it's noble to both acquire it and pass it down.
sentences.zh: 我仍然相信，有些知识和经验只有你能获得，而且我认为去获得它、再把它传递下去，是一件高尚的事。

sentences.en: But the format or vessel of how we pass down that knowledge needs to evolve, as it always has, from speaking by the fire to sending letters to building libraries to the day.
sentences.zh: 但我们传递知识的格式或载体需要进化，就像它一直在进化那样——从围坐在火边口述，到寄信，到建图书馆，一直到今天。

sentences.en: Everything changed when the internet was born.
sentences.zh: 互联网诞生的那一天，一切都变了。

sentences.en: Static courses don't cut it anymore.
sentences.zh: 静态课程已经不够用了。

sentences.en: And I mean they do, but because it's not like they just go to zero one day.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它们确实还能卖，因为不会某一天突然归零。

sentences.en: But the general market sentiment is burnt out.
sentences.zh: 但市场的普遍情绪是疲惫了。

sentences.en: A ten hour video library where someone just, like, sits down and watches it for ten hours isn't something that people want that much anymore.
sentences.zh: 一个十小时的视频库，让人坐在那里看上十个小时，这已经不是人们那么想要的东西了。

sentences.en: It feels slow and they know that there is something out there that is more efficient.
sentences.zh: 它感觉很慢，而且他们知道外面有更高效的东西。

sentences.en: Plus, it doesn't help that 90% of people that buy a course don't actually go through it and don't even get results from it.
sentences.zh: 另外，90% 买了课程的人根本不会看完，甚至根本得不到任何结果，这也没什么帮助。

sentences.en: And now with AI, anyone can just generate that information if they know what to ask, which is kind of unlikely, because why would they be interested in the info product in the first place if they knew what to ask?
sentences.zh: 而现在有了 AI，任何人只要知道该问什么，就能直接生成那些信息——但问题是，如果他们一开始就知道该问什么，又怎么会对那个信息产品感兴趣呢？

sentences.en: That said, the future of education in my eyes is learning experiences rather than static courses.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，在我眼中，教育的未来是学习体验，而不是静态课程。

sentences.en: You're not only selling information anymore, you're practically selling the second version of your mind.
sentences.zh: 你不再只是在卖信息了，你实际上是在卖你大脑的第二个版本。

sentences.en: You're selling your coaching services.
sentences.zh: 你是在卖你的教练服务。

sentences.en: So to say, but you aren't there.
sentences.zh: 可以这么说，但你本人并不在场。

sentences.en: Instead, you pass off everything you know to the AI and let people learn at their own speed.
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是，你把你所知道的一切交给 AI，让人们按照自己的节奏去学习。

sentences.en: Now, the question here is like, oh, but what about schools that are implementing AI to teach like this?
sentences.zh: 那么问题来了：那些正在引入 AI 来这样教学的学校呢？

sentences.en: Aren't you competing with them?
sentences.zh: 你不是在和它们竞争吗？

sentences.en: No, because schools teach people what they need to operate within society.
sentences.zh: 不是，因为学校教的是人们在社会中运转所需的东西。

sentences.en: Preferably you're teaching people something that very few people know about and schools wouldn't even think to teach.
sentences.zh: 而你教的，最好是极少数人知道、学校根本想不到去教的东西。

sentences.en: You are placing a price tag on your own curiosity and self-improvement.
sentences.zh: 你是在给自己的好奇心和自我提升标上价格。

sentences.en: So that leads into part four, which is how this actually works.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了第四部分：这套东西到底怎么运转。

sentences.en: AI is great for utility based tasks, but not so much for meaning based tasks.
sentences.zh: AI 在工具型任务上很强，但在意义型任务上就没那么强了。

sentences.en: That is, unless you find a way to work it into your workflow in a meaningful way, which I plan to talk about.
sentences.zh: 除非你能找到一种方式，把它有意义地融入你的工作流——这个我打算展开讲。

sentences.en: I plan to do a video on the future of writing, but that will really apply to almost any skill.
sentences.zh: 我计划做一期关于写作未来的视频，但它其实适用于几乎所有技能。

sentences.en: It's worth watching even if you're not a writer.
sentences.zh: 即使你不是写作者，也值得一看。

sentences.en: As an example, I had I do a ton of writing for me last month.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，上个月我让 AI 帮我写了大量内容。

sentences.en: I'm talking like 30 articles in two hours, but this isn't the typical writing that I would do in my newsletters that I derive a lot of meaning from, because I would have to be a lot more critical of what the AI writes.
sentences.zh: 我是说，大概两小时搞出 30 篇文章，但这跟我平时在 newsletter 里写的那种东西不一样，那种写作我从中获得很多意义，因为我对 AI 写的东西会挑剔得多。

sentences.en: So for this little project where I generated these articles, I was building a help center for Eden for my software.
sentences.zh: 在这个生成文章的小项目里，我是在给我的软件 Eden 搭建一个帮助中心。

sentences.en: That way I could have the support agent or future support agent to reference that as a knowledge base when they have questions, or they can ask questions to it because you can just ask questions with AI.
sentences.zh: 这样我的客服人员、或者未来的客服人员，就可以把它当作知识库来参考，遇到问题直接查，或者直接向它提问——因为用 AI 你直接问就行了。

sentences.en: So rather than reading through all of those articles, the support agent can just surface the right answer when they need it.
sentences.zh: 所以客服不用把所有文章读一遍，需要的时候直接调出正确答案就行。

sentences.en: And since I wrote these and I have them all inside of a AI project, I can just add to them at any time.
sentences.zh: 而且因为这些是我写的，全部放在一个 AI 项目里，我随时可以往里加内容。

sentences.en: Whenever we release a new feature, I can just be like, hey, I need to write a Help Center article for this.
sentences.zh: 每次我们发布新功能，我就可以说：嘿，我需要为这个写一篇帮助中心文章。

sentences.en: Here's exactly what it does.
sentences.zh: 这是它的具体功能。

sentences.en: Ask me clarifying questions if you need.
sentences.zh: 有需要就问我澄清性问题。

sentences.en: It's going to pull from the other help center articles and present like an outline for it.
sentences.zh: 它会参考其他帮助中心文章，然后给我一个提纲。

sentences.en: And then I'm going to be like, okay, looks good, fill it in, and then I'm going to read over that and make sure it's all accurate.
sentences.zh: 然后我就说：好，看起来不错，填充内容，接着我会通读一遍，确保全部准确。

sentences.en: Which is funny because all of the antique AI people, they always say like, oh, I make so much mistakes.
sentences.zh: 这挺搞笑的，因为那些反 AI 的人总说：哦，它犯好多错误。

sentences.en: Just read through and correct the mistakes.
sentences.zh: 读一遍，把错误改掉就行了。

sentences.en: And that still saves you a ton of time.
sentences.zh: 这仍然帮你省了大量时间。

sentences.en: That doesn't mean that AI isn't good.
sentences.zh: 这不代表 AI 不好用。

sentences.en: And the other thing here is that we use intercom, which is an incredible software.
sentences.zh: 另外一点是，我们用 Intercom，一款非常棒的软件。

sentences.en: They are on the front lines.
sentences.zh: 他们站在最前线。

sentences.en: I'm actually surprised of how such a large corporation can change things so fast, because they have thin their AI agent, which can now reference this knowledge base from our website and answer questions before our support agent does, which helps resolve the like redundant questions where there doesn't need to be a human in the loop.
sentences.zh: 我其实很惊讶，这么大一家公司能如此快速地改变产品，因为他们推出了 AI 客服代理，现在可以直接引用我们网站上的知识库，在人工客服介入之前就回答问题，这能解决那些重复性问题，根本不需要人类参与。

sentences.en: And if you're interested in how I did this, I really just went into cloud and I asked it, hey, go and research how other big companies like Notion or Meero or other companies structure their help center and propose a list of all the articles I need.
sentences.zh: 如果你好奇我是怎么做到的，我其实就是打开 Claude，跟它说：嘿，去研究一下 Notion、Miro 这些大公司是怎么搭建帮助中心的，然后给我出一份我需要写的所有文章清单。

sentences.en: Here's information about my company, here's the features we have, and then it spat out a list and he's like, okay, do you want me to go through and write these?
sentences.zh: 这是我的公司信息，这是我们有的功能，然后它就吐出一份清单，接着问：好的，要我逐一写出来吗？

sentences.en: I'm like, yes, but ask clarifying questions along the way so that they're accurate. Do not make assumptions.
sentences.zh: 我说：要，但过程中要问我澄清性问题，确保内容准确。不要做假设。

sentences.en: And then I just spent like an hour or two going through answering the questions, and all of the articles were spit out and two hours sounds like a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 然后我大概花了一两个小时回答问题，所有文章就全出来了——两小时听起来好像很久。

sentences.en: But 30 articles, 30 decent articles takes a long time to write.
sentences.zh: 但 30 篇文章，30 篇像样的文章，正常写要花很长时间。

sentences.en: And it's just annoying, mind numbing.
sentences.zh: 而且很烦人，让人脑子发木。

sentences.en: Answering questions with the AI is like kind of more enjoyable.
sentences.zh: 跟 AI 一问一答反而更有意思一点。

sentences.en: It's kind of like a game. It's fun.
sentences.zh: 有点像玩游戏，挺有趣的。

sentences.en: So outside of the Help Center, just take that same concept and apply it to courses or coaching or info products.
sentences.zh: 所以除了帮助中心，把这个思路套到课程、教练服务或信息产品上。

sentences.en: Imagine a course, but the course material was actually a knowledge base, and the chat bot that you have isn't for support.
sentences.zh: 想象一门课程，但课程内容其实是一个知识库，而你的聊天机器人不是用来做客服的。

sentences.en: The chat bot instead is there to help people learn, practice, and implement the knowledge base or the course that's not on the front end.
sentences.zh: 这个聊天机器人是用来帮人学习、练习、落地那个知识库或课程的——它不在前端展示。

sentences.en: That's not something that people go through.
sentences.zh: 那不是人们真正会经历的过程。

sentences.en: They learn it in a more interactive manner.
sentences.zh: 他们用更有互动性的方式去学。

sentences.en: And I'm just talking about something that is relatively beginner level here. Right?
sentences.zh: 我在这里说的还只是相对入门级别的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: You're not going and building the next like, billion dollar software company.
sentences.zh: 你不是要去打造下一个十亿美元的软件公司。

sentences.en: You're building something small scale.
sentences.zh: 你是在做一个小规模的东西。

sentences.en: That is the next level up from an info product that one person businesses can sell to a specific person on a specific topic.
sentences.zh: 这是比信息产品更高一级的东西，一人企业可以把它卖给特定的人，解决特定的问题。

sentences.en: The thing here is that an AI helping you do something like write a newsletter, or learn to write or write social media content, kind of like a coach that's sitting next to you and correcting you and helping you learn is much more effective than the course itself.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，AI 帮你做一些事，比如写 newsletter、学写作、或者写社交媒体内容，就像一个坐在你旁边的教练，纠正你、帮你学习，这比课程本身有效得多。

sentences.en: And so the distinction here is everyone thinks they should go and build the next thing that does all of it for you, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这里的区别在于，所有人都觉得他们应该去打造下一个能帮你搞定一切的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: The agent that just writes all of your social media content, when I don't think that's the way to go.
sentences.zh: 那种直接帮你写完所有社交媒体内容的 agent，我觉得那不是正确的方向。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: We're still talking about education products here, and I think those are inherently more valuable because people have the drive to learn, and it's just a valuable thing to do to think that AI is just going to make learning irrelevant is kind of silly.
sentences.zh: 我们这里谈的还是教育产品，我觉得这类产品本质上更有价值，因为人们有学习的动力，而且认为 AI 会让学习变得无关紧要，这种想法挺蠢的。

sentences.en: So this is what I mean by learning experiences.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所说的学习体验。

sentences.en: They're actually interacting, they're getting feedback.
sentences.zh: 他们真的在互动，真的在获得反馈。

sentences.en: They're doing the thing with guidance.
sentences.zh: 他们在有指导的情况下动手做。

sentences.en: That's the main differentiator.
sentences.zh: 这才是核心的差异化。

sentences.en: That's the main value proposition because learning by doing is the best way to learn.
sentences.zh: 这才是核心的价值主张，因为做中学是最好的学习方式。

sentences.en: So hopefully people just aren't stuck in tutorial hell anymore.
sentences.zh: 所以希望人们不要再困在教程地狱里了。

sentences.en: Going through endless tutorials and courses, they come away from your quote unquote learning experience with something.
sentences.zh: 不再是无休止地刷教程和课程，而是从你所谓的"学习体验"中真正带走一些东西。

sentences.en: A final product, just by nature of how you go through it.
sentences.zh: 一个成品，仅仅通过你经历这个过程的方式自然产生。

sentences.en: Because a lot of people that go through a course aren't actually going to do the thing.
sentences.zh: 因为很多上完一门课的人，其实根本不会真的去做那件事。

sentences.en: The other thing here is that this isn't new.
sentences.zh: 还有一点是，这根本不是什么新东西。

sentences.en: Before mass education existed, this is exactly how knowledge was passed down through apprenticeship.
sentences.zh: 在大众教育出现之前，知识就是这样通过学徒制传承的。

sentences.en: A blacksmith didn't hand as apprentice a manual and just say, figure it out.
sentences.zh: 铁匠不会丢给学徒一本手册然后说，自己琢磨吧。

sentences.en: He worked alongside him, corrected his grip in real time, and pointed out mistakes as they happened.
sentences.zh: 他和学徒一起干活，实时纠正他的握法，在错误发生时当场指出来。

sentences.en: This is why continue saying that we're going through the return of the artisan or the next Renaissance, because we're kind of looping back to a lot more meaningful things.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我一直在说，我们正在经历工匠精神的回归，或者说下一个文艺复兴，因为我们正在绕回到很多更有意义的事情上。

sentences.en: We're kind of correcting the mistakes that came with industrialization, because after that period of apprenticeship, we industrialized education.
sentences.zh: 我们正在纠正工业化带来的错误，因为在那个学徒制时期之后，我们把教育工业化了。

sentences.en: We needed to train thousands of workers quickly.
sentences.zh: 我们需要快速培训出成千上万的工人。

sentences.en: So we created the lecture model one teacher, many students standardized curriculum.
sentences.zh: 所以我们创造了讲课模式，一个老师，很多学生，标准化课程。

sentences.en: It's efficient for scale, but it's terrible for actually learning.
sentences.zh: 规模化效率很高，但对真正的学习来说糟透了。

sentences.en: But it turned out to be great for indoctrinating.
sentences.zh: 但它对灌输思想倒是非常好用。

sentences.en: So for the first time since the apprenticeship model, we can have personalized, interactive guidance at scale.
sentences.zh: 所以自学徒制模式以来，我们第一次可以大规模地提供个性化、互动式的指导。

sentences.en: This won't click yet for people that just think AI is the worst thing in the world, because they don't see this as an option.
sentences.zh: 对于那些觉得 AI 是世界上最糟糕的东西的人来说，这一点还不会触动他们，因为他们看不到这个选项。

sentences.en: They see AI as a thing that just does everything and removes all of the meaningful things from our lives, but that is a choice.
sentences.zh: 他们把 AI 看作一个包办一切、从我们生活中夺走所有意义的东西，但那是一种选择。

sentences.en: So if I were to do this as an example, I have my course, the Two Hour writer.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我拿这个举个例子，我有我的课程，Two Hour Writer。

sentences.en: I would create the modules for it and that would turn into a knowledge base.
sentences.zh: 我会为它创建各个模块，这些模块会变成一个知识库。

sentences.en: It's already done since I have the course, so you don't really skip that process.
sentences.zh: 因为我已经有这门课了，所以这一步其实不用再走一遍。

sentences.en: And then I would build some kind of interactive chat bot.
sentences.zh: 然后我会做一个交互式聊天机器人。

sentences.en: I don't know exactly what it would look like.
sentences.zh: 具体长什么样我还不确定。

sentences.en: I'm not going to do this.
sentences.zh: 我不打算做这个。

sentences.en: I haven't done this.
sentences.zh: 我还没做过。

sentences.en: I'm building two companies right now, but if I were still a one person business, then this is probably something that I would take seriously.
sentences.zh: 我现在在同时建两家公司，但如果我仍然是一人企业，这件事我大概会认真对待。

sentences.en: So I built something like a small software. Right.
sentences.zh: 所以我会做一个小型软件，对吧。

sentences.en: And this would take me a bit because I'm not a programmer, and I understand that the programing or vibe coding tools today still require you to learn a decent amount.
sentences.zh: 这需要花点时间，因为我不是程序员，而且我知道现在的编程或 vibe coding 工具，你仍然得学不少东西。

sentences.en: If you don't want to, make a mistake and then not be able to solve it, and then either have to hire someone or just quit.
sentences.zh: 如果你不想犯错之后解决不了，然后要么得雇人，要么直接放弃。

sentences.en: So you're going to have to learn.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须得学。

sentences.en: But for something like this, an interactive chat bot, I think this is one of the simpler things that you can do.
sentences.zh: 但对于像这样的交互式聊天机器人，我觉得这是你能做的比较简单的东西之一。

sentences.en: So in my example, the software would have like three tabs.
sentences.zh: 用我的例子来说，这个软件大概会有三个标签页。

sentences.en: There would be learn, practice and create.
sentences.zh: 分别是学习、练习和创作。

sentences.en: In each of those would have their own prompts, which we'll talk about in a bit.
sentences.zh: 每个标签页都有自己的提示词，我们待会再聊这个。

sentences.en: So there'd be a learning prompt that guides people through how to learn, or there be multiple prompts on each page so people can click in order and kind of go through the interactive lessons,
sentences.zh: 会有一个学习提示词，引导人们怎么去学，或者每个页面有多个提示词，人们可以按顺序点击，一步步完成互动课程，

sentences.en: I guess you could say.
sentences.zh: 可以这么说。

sentences.en: And then in the practice tab, it would be kind of the same thing.
sentences.zh: 然后在练习标签页，差不多也是同样的逻辑。

sentences.en: It'd be prompts that take from the lessons and tell them to try something and then grades them on it.
sentences.zh: 提示词会从课程内容里取材，让他们尝试做某件事，然后给他们打分。

sentences.en: And then there would be the create tab, which is again kind of the same thing.
sentences.zh: 接着是创作标签页，基本也是同样的思路。

sentences.en: So this leads into part five, which is how to build a micro SaaS or software as a service.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了第五部分：怎么做一个微型 SaaS，也就是软件即服务。

sentences.en: And this is going to be non-exhaustive.
sentences.zh: 这部分不会讲得面面俱到。

sentences.en: So again I don't think that info products are going to be dead completely any time soon.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我不认为信息产品短期内会彻底消亡。

sentences.en: Education is just too important for the human brain and choosing what to be educated on based on goals you derive for yourself is still one of the last modes.
sentences.zh: 教育对人脑来说太重要了，而根据你自己设定的目标来选择学什么，这仍然是最后的阵地之一。

sentences.en: Learning is too foundational to the human experience to ever be fully commoditized.
sentences.zh: 学习是人类体验中太根本的东西，不可能被完全商品化。

sentences.en: With that said, I think that info products are going to look more like software over the next few years.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我认为未来几年信息产品会越来越像软件。

sentences.en: Rather than having an e-book to download, you have a website to visit or an app to install, and idea just came to mind.
sentences.zh: 不再是下载一本电子书，而是访问一个网站或安装一个应用——我刚想到一个点子。

sentences.en: I feel like a lot of the course platforms are going to pivot in some large way to help people create courses better, right?
sentences.zh: 我感觉很多课程平台会以某种大方式转型，帮人们更好地做课程，对吧？

sentences.en: Because they're all implementing agents and things that you can use to help you, like build the course.
sentences.zh: 因为它们都在接入 agent 和各种工具，帮你搭建课程。

sentences.en: But what about on the end user? How are they?
sentences.zh: 但终端用户那边呢？他们怎么办？

sentences.en: How is the AI going to bring value to the end user?
sentences.zh: AI 要怎么给终端用户带来价值？

sentences.en: So if you want to get into that industry of building a course or information product platform, then help people do this rather than having an e-book to download, you would have a website to visit or an app to install.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想进入做课程或信息产品平台这个行业，那就帮人们做这件事——不再是下载一本电子书，而是访问一个网站或安装一个应用。

sentences.en: I have a few business friends who are already doing this.
sentences.zh: 我有几个做生意的朋友已经在做这个了。

sentences.en: I know one that created an offer creation app that helps you identify your best ideas, turn them into a compelling offer, and go beyond that.
sentences.zh: 我认识一个人做了一个 offer 创建应用，帮你识别最好的想法，把它们变成有吸引力的 offer，甚至更进一步。

sentences.en: As another example, rather than selling something like a How to Talk to Girls e-book course or coaching program, you create a chat bot that simulates them talking to girls.
sentences.zh: 再举个例子，与其卖什么"如何跟女生聊天"的电子书、课程或教练服务，你不如做一个聊天机器人，模拟他们跟女生对话的场景。

sentences.en: This is a really this is a cop out example, but it like teaches you how to text, right?
sentences.zh: 这个例子有点取巧，但它确实能教你发信息，对吧？

sentences.en: That's one very profitable industry, which is unfortunate, but another example is rather than a productivity course, you create an AI that helps them identify their vision and outline their primary tasks and gives them notifications when things aren't complete.
sentences.zh: 这是一个利润极高的行业，虽然挺可悲的。再举一个例子，与其做一个效率课程，你不如做一个 AI，帮他们理清愿景、列出核心任务，并在事情没完成时发通知提醒。

sentences.en: And it can even be integrated into like a simple to do app.
sentences.zh: 甚至可以集成到一个简易的待办应用里。

sentences.en: But that's just much more enticing than something like buy my course now.
sentences.zh: 这比"现在就买我的课"有吸引力多了。

sentences.en: If you've been following any of my videos at all, or if you've seen the prompts that I've given out, you kind of know what I'm getting at here.
sentences.zh: 如果你一直在看我的视频，或者见过我分享的那些提示词，你大概已经明白我的意思了。

sentences.en: So any of the prompts that I've sent to my email list, I'll link some of those in the description.
sentences.zh: 我发给邮件列表的那些提示词，我会在简介里放几个链接。

sentences.en: Those could easily be turned into a Microsoft, where you just have to create a UI for those things and set that as the system instructions.
sentences.zh: 那些东西很容易就能变成一个产品，你只需要给它们做个界面，然后把这些提示词设为系统指令。

sentences.en: I've also taught how to create good prompts in my video.
sentences.zh: 我在视频里也教过怎么写好提示词。

sentences.en: How to use AI better than 99% of people.
sentences.zh: 那期叫《如何比 99% 的人更好地使用 AI》。

sentences.en: I think it's a few videos ago, but these would become the system prompts of your little AI app.
sentences.zh: 应该是前几期视频了，这些提示词就会成为你那个小 AI 应用的系统提示。

sentences.en: So rather than creating a very general chat GPT, you create a hyper specific chat or software that helps people learn, practice, and do the thing you were teaching about in the first place with the info product.
sentences.zh: 所以你不是做一个泛泛的 ChatGPT，而是做一个高度聚焦的聊天工具或软件，帮人们学习、练习、去做你原本想用信息产品教的那件事。

sentences.en: The question here is but Dan is in building a chat GPT wrapper cheating.
sentences.zh: 问题来了：Dan，做一个 ChatGPT 套壳应用算不算作弊？

sentences.en: Well, by that logic, building anything on the internet is cheating.
sentences.zh: 按这个逻辑，互联网上做任何东西都是作弊。

sentences.en: Tight form $1 billion company is just an HTML wrapper.
sentences.zh: Tight form，一家价值 10 亿美元的公司，不过是个 HTML 套壳。

sentences.en: Cursor is a GPT wrapper.
sentences.zh: Cursor 是个 GPT 套壳。

sentences.en: Any info product you build is wrapped by the platform you build it on.
sentences.zh: 你做的任何信息产品，都是被你所用的平台套了一层壳。

sentences.en: And if AI is like the next cloud solution, which I think it is, every piece of software on the internet will be a wrapper.
sentences.zh: 如果 AI 是下一个云解决方案——我认为它就是——那互联网上的每一款软件都会是套壳。

sentences.en: So yes, as one person who has to be savvy with their resources and use third party tools, a chat GPT wrapper is a great way to go.
sentences.zh: 所以没错，作为一个人，你必须精打细算地利用资源、善用第三方工具，ChatGPT 套壳是一条很好的路。

sentences.en: So you create the course kind of like you would the knowledge base for a help center.
sentences.zh: 所以你创建课程的方式，就有点像搭建帮助中心的知识库。

sentences.en: You build out all the articles, you practically create the course, and then you create what's called a system prompt or multiple of these.
sentences.zh: 你写好所有文章，基本上把课程做出来，然后创建一个叫"系统提示"的东西，或者多个。

sentences.en: So like we just talked about a system prompt is a set of instructions you give to an AI before it talks to anyone.
sentences.zh: 就像我们刚才说的，系统提示是你在 AI 跟任何人对话之前，给它的一套指令。

sentences.en: It defines the AI personality, knowledge boundaries and behavior rules.
sentences.zh: 它定义了 AI 的人格、知识边界和行为规则。

sentences.en: You think of this as programing.
sentences.zh: 你可以把这理解为编程。

sentences.en: The AI is identity.
sentences.zh: 编程的是 AI 的身份。

sentences.en: For example, if you're creating an AI writing coach, your system prompt might include the AI role.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，如果你在做一个 AI 写作教练，你的系统提示可能包括 AI 的角色。

sentences.en: So how the AI should act, its instructions, what exactly it should do step by step.
sentences.zh: 也就是 AI 应该怎么行动；它的指令，具体要一步步做什么。

sentences.en: It's knowledge base.
sentences.zh: 它的知识库。

sentences.en: So all of your frameworks, processes and examples, its boundaries, what it should and shouldn't help with and its personality.
sentences.zh: 也就是你所有的框架、流程和案例；它的边界，什么该帮、什么不该帮；还有它的人格。

sentences.en: So how it talks, what Tony uses, how harsh or supportive it is, and the prompt is what makes your AI different from everyone else's. It's your specific knowledge, your frameworks, and your voice that can help thousands of people at once.
sentences.zh: 也就是它怎么说话、用什么语气、有多严厉或多支持。这个提示词就是让你的 AI 跟别人不一样的地方。它是你的独特知识、你的框架、你的声音，能同时帮到成千上万的人。

sentences.en: Now, can people steal this?
sentences.zh: 那别人能偷这个吗？

sentences.en: Probably, but they could have stolen anything you build.
sentences.zh: 可能吧，但你做的任何东西别人都能偷。

sentences.en: That's just like never a valid response.
sentences.zh: 这从来不是一个站得住脚的理由。

sentences.en: Or what if they steal my idea again, most people just don't do anything.
sentences.zh: 或者"别人偷了我的创意怎么办"——再说一次，大多数人根本什么都不做。

sentences.en: And now, part six how to actually build the software.
sentences.zh: 现在，第六部分：如何真正把软件做出来。

sentences.en: And you just use a tool like Replit or cursor, or you can even try cloud code, which is a terminal app.
sentences.zh: 你就用 Replit 或 Cursor 这类工具，甚至也可以试试 Claude Code，那是个终端应用。

sentences.en: And I haven't done this, but inside of cloud there's like a code tab that you can click on.
sentences.zh: 我还没用过，但在 Claude 里面有个代码标签页可以点进去。

sentences.en: So maybe try that.
sentences.zh: 所以可以试试那个。

sentences.en: And the thing here is that yes, you will have to learn how to use this. Right.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，没错，你得学会怎么用这些东西。

sentences.en: We've we've heard the AI hype and we know that I just at least now isn't this thing that just solves all of our problems and lets us do nothing and just can execute commands exactly how we ask?
sentences.zh: 我们都听过 AI 的炒作，我们也知道，至少现在，它还不是那种能解决所有问题、让我们什么都不用做、还能完全按我们的指令执行的东西。

sentences.en: I don't think it can ever do that, right?
sentences.zh: 我觉得它永远做不到那个程度，对吧？

sentences.en: Because how can you get so much context into one sentence, right?
sentences.zh: 因为你怎么可能把那么多上下文塞进一句话里？

sentences.en: You can say, hey, create this YouTube video for me.
sentences.zh: 你可以说，嘿，帮我做这个 YouTube 视频。

sentences.en: How is it going to know what kind of YouTube video, what kind of this, what kind of this? How is it structured?
sentences.zh: 它怎么知道你要什么类型的 YouTube 视频、什么风格、什么结构？

sentences.en: What's the pacing, what's the tone, how long?
sentences.zh: 节奏是什么，语气是什么，时长多少？

sentences.en: What are all of the ideas that you're going to include in there?
sentences.zh: 你要放进视频里的所有想法是什么？

sentences.en: Is it just going to assume those and make those up.
sentences.zh: 难道它就自己假设、自己编吗？

sentences.en: And then you're going to put it under your name?
sentences.zh: 然后你还要把它署上你的名字？

sentences.en: That's not how this stuff works.
sentences.zh: 事情不是这么运作的。

sentences.en: So the best way to learn something like this is to one just start tinkering and experimenting.
sentences.zh: 所以学这种东西最好的方式，第一，就是直接开始捣鼓和实验。

sentences.en: Once you start tinkering and experimenting, then start watching YouTube tutorials on how to use those things, and you have to have a project that you're building towards.
sentences.zh: 一旦你开始捣鼓和实验，再去看 YouTube 教程，学怎么用那些工具，而且你必须有一个正在推进的项目。

sentences.en: You have to have an idea for this quote unquote info product or evolved info product that you're building.
sentences.zh: 你必须对你正在做的这个所谓“信息产品”或者进化版信息产品有一个想法。

sentences.en: And then when you watch the YouTube tutorials, they're not going to be about how to build that.
sentences.zh: 然后当你看 YouTube 教程的时候，它们不会教你怎么做你的那个东西。

sentences.en: So you're going to have to adapt and apply what they teach to what you're doing.
sentences.zh: 所以你得把教程里教的东西，适配和应用到你自己正在做的事情上。

sentences.en: And if you get stuck, you can just ask AI how to do specific things.
sentences.zh: 如果卡住了，你可以直接问 AI 怎么做具体的事。

sentences.en: I do this all the time. Right now.
sentences.zh: 我一直在这么做。现在就是。

sentences.en: I literally ask it how to do things in Photoshop or Framer all the time, and it pulls from the help centers of those things or forums.
sentences.zh: 我几乎天天问它怎么在 Photoshop 或 Framer 里做某件事，它会从那些工具的帮助中心或者论坛里找答案。

sentences.en: An example of what you can do here is you can just ask, like, give me a comprehensive guide on how to vibe code correctly, and then you can ask it to create a comprehensive guide on what you're trying to build, right.
sentences.zh: 你能做的一个例子是，你可以直接问：给我一份关于如何正确进行“氛围编程”的完整指南，然后你可以让它针对你想做的东西出一份完整指南。

sentences.en: How to create a comprehensive guide on building this AI chat app with these many tabs on this specific topic.
sentences.zh: 比如，如何为这个特定主题、带这么多标签页的 AI 聊天应用，出一份完整构建指南。

sentences.en: With this knowledge base, ask clarifying questions on the product if you need it.
sentences.zh: 带上这个知识库，如果需要的话，让它针对产品问一些澄清性问题。

sentences.en: And I'm one singular person with this budget, so on and so forth. And you just converse.
sentences.zh: 我是一个人，预算就这么多，等等等等。然后你就跟它对话。

sentences.en: Now the thing here is that this is just like any other skill, right?
sentences.zh: 这里的关键是，这跟学任何其他技能一样，对吧？

sentences.en: You don't start riding a bike immediately, you kind of fall off and then you try again.
sentences.zh: 你不可能一上来就会骑自行车，你会摔下来，然后再试。

sentences.en: I think it's frustrating.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很让人沮丧。

sentences.en: Everyone's in this like like super.
sentences.zh: 每个人都处于一种超级——

sentences.en: They need the quick result really fast.
sentences.zh: 他们需要极快地拿到结果。

sentences.en: If they don't get results the first time around, then they quit.
sentences.zh: 如果第一次没拿到结果，他们就放弃了。

sentences.en: But that's not how skill acquisition works.
sentences.zh: 但技能的获得不是这么回事。

sentences.en: You're going to feel weird.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得别扭。

sentences.en: You're going to feel overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得喘不过气。

sentences.en: You're going to feel like you're not making progress for a bit.
sentences.zh: 你会有一段时间觉得自己毫无进展。

sentences.en: That's just how it goes.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: You're going to have to build 3 to 4 apps before you feel like you can actually put a price tag on one.
sentences.zh: 你得先做出三四个应用，才能真正觉得自己能给某个应用标个价。

sentences.en: That's why it's important to start now, because remember what I talked about is that the change is going to happen really fast.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么现在就开始很重要，因为记住我说的，变化会来得非常快。

sentences.en: It's going to happen faster than before.
sentences.zh: 会比以前更快。

sentences.en: Info products died in 10 or 15 years.
sentences.zh: 信息产品用了十年、十五年才死掉。

sentences.en: This may die in 2 to 3 years.
sentences.zh: 这个可能两三年就会死。

sentences.en: And then after that we don't even know what things are going to look like.
sentences.zh: 再往后，我们甚至不知道事情会变成什么样。

sentences.en: And you're going to have to adapt on the fly.
sentences.zh: 你必须边飞边适应。

sentences.en: So the question now is where does your advantage actually lie?
sentences.zh: 所以现在的问题是，你的优势到底在哪里？

sentences.en: Your advantage isn't doing what I can't do because that's a losing game.
sentences.zh: 你的优势不是去做我做不了的事，因为那是一场必输的游戏。

sentences.en: Your advantage is doing what only you would think to do with AI.
sentences.zh: 你的优势是，去做只有你才会想到用 AI 去做的事。

sentences.en: Not everyone types the same thing in the chat GPT or Replit or cursor, meaning the output of those things are infinitely unique.
sentences.zh: 不是每个人在 ChatGPT、Replit 或 Cursor 里输入的东西都一样，这意味着它们的输出是无限独特的。

sentences.en: Your unique combination of interests, experiences, and insights leads to prompts and products that nobody else would create.
sentences.zh: 你独特的兴趣、经历和洞察组合，会催生出别人永远创造不出的提示词和产品。

sentences.en: Nivel rather explains this as specific knowledge.
sentences.zh: Naval 把这解释为特定知识。

sentences.en: Specific knowledge can't be trained for.
sentences.zh: 特定知识是没法被训练出来的。

sentences.en: It comes from pursuing genuine curiosity.
sentences.zh: 它来自追随真正的好奇心。

sentences.en: Building it will feel like play to you.
sentences.zh: 构建它的过程对你来说就像玩一样。

sentences.en: It's often at the edge of knowledge.
sentences.zh: 它往往处在知识的边缘。

sentences.en: The person who spent ten years obsessing over productivity, and then they go and build this AI software is going to build something so much more nuanced and detailed that someone who hasn't spent that much time in their domain, and it's going to be so much better and more nuanced than the person who just goes to ChatGPT or Claude and tells them to build a productivity app.
sentences.zh: 一个花了十年痴迷于生产力的人，然后去构建一个 AI 软件，他做出来的东西会比那些没在自己领域花那么多时间的人细致得多、精妙得多，而且会比那些只是去 ChatGPT 或 Claude 让它做一个生产力应用的人做出来的东西好得多、细腻得多。

sentences.en: And if that obsessed person has built an audience on social media with said specific knowledge around productivity, then they're at even more of an advantage.
sentences.zh: 如果这个痴迷的人还在社交媒体上用这些生产力相关的特定知识建立起了受众，那他的优势就更大了。

sentences.en: So we talked about how info products are dead.
sentences.zh: 我们聊过了信息产品已经死了。

sentences.en: In this video, we're going to talk about the whole value based content thing is dead in another video.
sentences.zh: 在这个视频里，我们会在另一个视频里聊基于价值的内容那套东西也死了。

sentences.en: So the irony here is that AI is making human knowledge more valuable, not less.
sentences.zh: 所以讽刺的是，AI 正在让人类知识变得更有价值，而不是更没价值。

sentences.en: That's crazy.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: That's like a crazy insight because I made everyone fast.
sentences.zh: 这是一个疯狂的洞察，因为我让所有人都变快了。

sentences.en: Anyone can make a course, anyone can write content, anyone can copy anyone.
sentences.zh: 任何人都能做一个课程，任何人都能写内容，任何人都能复制任何人。

sentences.en: But very few people are un copyable.
sentences.zh: 但很少有人是不可复制的。

sentences.en: Very few people have spent years developing so much fine tuned experience or taste that nobody would think to copy the details that make it work.
sentences.zh: 很少有人花了多年时间，积累了如此精细打磨的经验或品味，以至于没人会想到去复制那些让它奏效的细节。

sentences.en: Build the thing that only you would build links in the description for the things that I mentioned throughout this video.
sentences.zh: 去构建那个只有你会构建的东西。描述里有这个视频里提到的所有东西的链接。

sentences.en: If you want to be notified when these videos go out, or you want to read the newsletter version of this video, subscribe to my newsletter and you'll get that.
sentences.zh: 如果你想在这些视频发布时收到通知，或者想看这个视频的 newsletter 版本，订阅我的 newsletter，你会收到的。

sentences.en: And if you download the Substack app, you'll also get a mobile notification when that newsletter goes out.
sentences.zh: 如果你下载 Substack 应用，你还会在 newsletter 发布时收到手机通知。

sentences.en: And of course, you can sign up for the Eden waitlist, which is the AI Canvas and Drive.
sentences.zh: 当然，你也可以注册 Eden 的候补名单，它是一个 AI 画布和云端硬盘。

sentences.en: So you can add any of your files.
sentences.zh: 你可以把任何文件添加进去。

sentences.en: You can paste links like a YouTube video, and it downloads them and transcribes them so they can be searched and referenced with AI.
sentences.zh: 你可以粘贴链接，比如 YouTube 视频，它会自动下载并转录，这样就能用 AI 搜索和引用这些内容。

sentences.en: And then you can drag them on to a canvas.
sentences.zh: 然后你可以把它们拖到画布上。

sentences.en: Any of your files, connect them to AI chats, and work in this unique and different way.
sentences.zh: 任何文件都可以，把它们连接到 AI 对话，用这种独特、不一样的方式工作。

sentences.en: In the next round of people that we bring into Eden off of, the waitlist will happen late January ish, and then we'll start prepping for our full public launch.
sentences.zh: 我们下一批从候补名单中邀请进入 Eden 的用户，大概会在 1 月底，之后我们就会开始准备全面公开发布。

sentences.en: So thank you for watching.
